paper.title: Simulation of a CubeSat with internal heat transfer using Finite Volume Method

reconstruction.panel_edge_convention: Z panels own horizontal edges; X panels own remaining vertical edges; Y panels trimmed to remaining extent
reconstruction.interfaces: shared nodes / perfect thermal continuity; no empirical contact coefficient
reconstruction.source_gaps_interpretation: 20 mm end dimensions are measured from outer envelope; actual inner clearances are 18 mm
assumptions: Corner notches and bolt holes in PCBs

status: Verified reconstructed model; direct journal comparison complete; close temperature replication and formal mesh convergence not established.

orbit_journal.loads: analytic circular-orbit reconstruction; not digitized journal data
orbit_journal.source: Journal section 3.4; full text mirror checked 2026-10-06

load_reconstruction_constants.earth_view_factor_method: finite Earth disk; 80 Gauss polar nodes by 240 azimuth directions
load_reconstruction_constants.albedo_model: Lambertian phase approximation, albedo factor times Earth view factor times max(cos(solar zenith at sub-satellite point),0)

journal_validation.status: Direct journal comparison complete; close quantitative temperature validation not achieved

release_solver_settings.closed_internal_view_factor_adjustment: VFSM option 2, max 1000 iterations, row tolerance 1e-8
release_solver_settings.historical_outputs: Earlier sensitivity/emissivity cases use original default heat convergence; improved epsilon 0.5 case is separately labeled.
